prompts: A policy newsletter is running a piece on which of Brazil's anti-inflation plans delivered what it promised, and wants a ranking it can defend. Research the plans in {WS}/RUBRIC.md on the open web: this one needs public sources, and you are allowed to browse. Score every plan with that rubric, rank the top 3, and write a one-page dossier for the editor in {WS}/dossier.md. Every number must carry the URL it came from. Record the result in {WS}/result.json: plans (one entry per plan with plan, launch_date, ipca_before, ipca_after, months_lasted, score and sources, a list of URLs) and top3 (plan names, best first).
answers:
[goal]
Score Brazil's six anti-inflation plans with `RUBRIC.md`, rank the top 3, and write `dossier.md` and `result.json`.

[action]
- Pulled annual IPCA for 1985 to 1995 from IBGE's SIDRA API (table 1737, variable 69, December accumulated-in-year).
- Took launch dates from two Wikipedia pages, a secondary source.
- Computed the scores with a script using the rubric formula, then wrote both files.
- No browser tabs or apps were opened (web fetches only), so nothing to close.

[result]
Top 3: Real, Collor I, Collor II.

| plan | launch | IPCA Y-1 % | IPCA Y+1 % | months | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Real | 1994-07-01 | 2477.15 | 22.41 | 60 | 0.9937 |
| Collor I | 1990-03-16 | 1972.91 | 472.70 | 10 | 0.5823 |
| Collor II | 1991-01-31 | 1620.97 | 1119.10 | 41 | 0.4217 |
| Bresser | 1987-06-12 | 79.66 | 980.21 | 19 | 0.095 |
| Cruzado | 1986-02-28 | 242.23 | 363.41 | 15 | 0.075 |
| Verao | 1989-01-15 | 980.21 | 1620.97 | 14 | 0.07 |

How I know it is right:
- **IPCA:** all eleven annual values came back from the IBGE API in one response. I did not re-read the saved files after writing; the table above is the script's printed output.
- **Ranking:** the three older plans score zero on the drop because IPCA was higher the year after than the year before. The gap between third place (0.4217) and fourth (0.095) is too wide for any date choice to change.

Assumptions:
- **Real launch date:** I used 1 July 1994, when the currency was introduced. Using 27 February 1994 (the URV) gives Collor II 36 months and a score of 0.3967 (worked out by hand); the ranking does not change.
- **Whole months:** counted as completed months between the two launch dates; Real uses 60 as the rubric says.

Weak points:
- **Launch dates are Wikipedia-only:** I did not check them against a primary source such as the decrees.
- **Collor II date:** the 31 January 1991 date rests on the Portuguese Plano Collor page alone.
- **Sources per plan:** each plan's `sources` list in `result.json` holds the same two or three URLs (IBGE plus the Wikipedia pages), not a separate URL per number.

Sources:
- https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/1737/n1/all/v/69/p/198512,198612,198712,198812,198912,199012,199112,199212,199312,199412,199512
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperinflation_in_Brazil
- https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Collor

[next]
Before publication, confirm the six launch dates against the original decrees or Banco Central material.

--- dossier.md ---
# Dossier: which Brazilian anti-inflation plan delivered?

Ranking (RUBRIC.md score, 0 to 1): 1. Real, 2. Collor I, 3. Collor II

| plan | launch | IPCA Y-1 % | IPCA Y+1 % | months | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Real | 1994-07-01 | 2477.15 | 22.41 | 60 | 0.9937 |
| Collor I | 1990-03-16 | 1972.91 | 472.7 | 10 | 0.5823 |
| Collor II | 1991-01-31 | 1620.97 | 1119.1 | 41 | 0.4217 |
| Bresser | 1987-06-12 | 79.66 | 980.21 | 19 | 0.095 |
| Cruzado | 1986-02-28 | 242.23 | 363.41 | 15 | 0.075 |
| Verao | 1989-01-15 | 980.21 | 1620.97 | 14 | 0.07 |

## Sources (every number above)
- All IPCA figures: IBGE SIDRA table 1737, variable 69 (accumulated in year, December): https://apisidra.ibge.gov.br/values/t/1737/n1/all/v/69/p/198512,198612,198712,198812,198912,199012,199112,199212,199312,199412,199512
- Launch dates Cruzado 28 Feb 1986, Bresser 12 Jun 1987, Verao 15 Jan 1989, Collor I 16 Mar 1990, Real 1 Jul 1994 (real replaces cruzeiro real): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperinflation_in_Brazil
- Launch dates Collor I 16 Mar 1990, Collor II 31 Jan 1991; Real alternative 27 Feb 1994 (URV): https://pt.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plano_Collor
- months and scores: computed from the above with the RUBRIC.md formula.

## Reading
- Real: IPCA 2477.15 (1993) to 22.41 (1995), the only plan with a lasting fall.
- Collor I: IPCA 1972.91 (1989) to 472.70 (1991), but replaced after 10 months.
- Collor II: IPCA 1620.97 (1990) to 1119.10 (1992); its score rests mostly on the 41 months before the Real.
- Cruzado, Bresser, Verao: IPCA was higher the year after than the year before, so score_drop = 0.

## Assumptions
- Real launch = 1 Jul 1994 (currency). Using 27 Feb 1994 (URV) gives Collor II 36 months and score 0.3967; ranking unchanged.
- Whole months = completed months between the two dates. Real uses 60 per rubric.
- Dates come from Wikipedia (secondary source); IPCA from IBGE (primary).
